name: A whispered tour of {X}
description: ASMR-leaning second-person walkthrough of a place, building, system, or moment in time. The listener is led gently through {X} — every sensory detail surfaced, no urgency, no exposition the listener didn't ask for. Pairs with Sleep Story; lighter pairing with Documentary.
openingDevice: Open with a soft, hushed welcome at the entrance to {X}. Address the listener in second person. Tell them you're going to walk them through it, slowly, with all the time in the world. Establish quiet and intimacy in the first paragraph — a hand on a railing, a soft door swing, the listener's own breath.
bodyStructure: Chapter 1: The threshold — entering {X}. What the listener sees first, hears first, the change in air quality or temperature

Chapters 2-{lastButOne}: Move through {X} room by room or zone by zone. Each chapter spends real time in one space — describe it as if narrating a film with no urgency. Sound, light, texture, what the eye catches and lets go
Chapter {last}: The exit, or the deepest interior point. A pause. The listener takes one last quiet look. Soft return to the threshold or an invitation to stay
closingDevice: Close with the listener leaving {X} (or being left inside it). Soft fade. The whispered cadence holds to the last sentence.
